title: Practice 7: Антон Чехов · Письмо брату Николаю (1886)

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Если только кончу ___ (гимназия), то прилечу в Москву на крыльях, она мне очень понравилась!
exercises.why: As mentioned above, the primary use of the accusative case is to denote the object of a verb. — From the Wikibooks Russian textbook (CC BY-SA 4.0). From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lesson 18.  ·  From Антон Чехов, «Письмо брату Николаю (1886)».
exercises.context: As mentioned above, the primary use of the accusative case is to denote the object of a verb.

exercises.q: Брависсимо, дело сделано… пойду стрелять, только не на ___ (двор).
exercises.why: **На**, 'onto' - as discussed earlier, this denotes onto which something is moving, such as 'I'm landing *onto* the roof'. — From the Wikibooks Russian textbook (CC BY-SA 4.0).  ·  From Антон Чехов, «Письмо брату Николаю (1886)».
exercises.context: На, 'onto' - as discussed earlier, this denotes onto which something is moving, such as 'I'm landing *onto* the roof'.

exercises.q: Не оставляй же, брат, меня без писем и извини за ___ (долгое молчание).
exercises.why: **За**, 'behind' - this denotes that you are moving to the rear of something, as in 'I'm walking *behind* the building'. — From the Wikibooks Russian textbook (CC BY-SA 4.0).  ·  From Антон Чехов, «Письмо брату Николаю (1886)».
exercises.context: За, 'behind' - this denotes that you are moving to the rear of something, as in 'I'm walking *behind* the building'.

exercises.why: **На**, 'onto' - as discussed earlier, this denotes onto which something is moving, such as 'I'm landing *onto* the roof'. — From the Wikibooks Russian textbook (CC BY-SA 4.0).  ·  From Антон Чехов, «Письмо брату Николаю (1886)».
exercises.context: На, 'onto' - as discussed earlier, this denotes onto which something is moving, such as 'I'm landing *onto* the roof'.

exercises.q: Кому надоело толковать про медицину, тот заводит речь про ___ (литература)…
exercises.why: **Про**, 'about' - this preposition means 'about', in the same way as **о** + *prep* does. — From the Wikibooks Russian textbook (CC BY-SA 4.0).  ·  From Антон Чехов, «Письмо брату Николаю (1886)».
exercises.context: Про**, 'about' - this preposition means 'about', in the same way as **о + *prep* does.

exercises.why: Like **под**, when no motion is involved, the instrumental case is used. — From the Wikibooks Russian textbook (CC BY-SA 4.0).  ·  From Антон Чехов, «Письмо брату Николаю (1886)».
exercises.context: Like **под**, when no motion is involved, the instrumental case is used.

exercises.q: Размещаются письма в хронологическом порядке, с ___ (единая нумерация) во всей серии.
exercises.why: b) Instrumental without **с** is used when an instrument or agent of the action is denoted. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lesson 30.  ·  From Антон Чехов, «Письмо брату Николаю (1886)».
exercises.context: b) Instrumental without **с** is used when an instrument or agent of the action is denoted.

exercises.q: Посылаю Вам нижайший поклон с ___ (горький) упреком.
exercises.why: b) Instrumental without **с** is used when an instrument or agent of the action is denoted. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lesson 30.  ·  From Антон Чехов, «Письмо брату Николаю (1886)».
exercises.context: b) Instrumental without **с** is used when an instrument or agent of the action is denoted.

exercises.q: В будущем году, если не буду за ___ (граница), буду у Вас.
exercises.why: **За** generally means 'behind' or 'beyond', but has a few nuances to it. — From the Wikibooks Russian textbook (CC BY-SA 4.0).  ·  From Антон Чехов, «Письмо брату Николаю (1886)».
exercises.context: За generally means 'behind' or 'beyond', but has a few nuances to it.

exercises.q: За сим займемся ___ (история) вообще и историей знаний.
exercises.why: b) Instrumental without **с** is used when an instrument or agent of the action is denoted. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lesson 30.  ·  From Антон Чехов, «Письмо брату Николаю (1886)».
exercises.context: b) Instrumental without **с** is used when an instrument or agent of the action is denoted.

exercises.q: Сейчас у сестры был целый цветник, и я таял, как жид перед ___ (червонец)…
exercises.why: **Перед** means 'before' or 'in front of' in terms of positioning, and can also indicate responsibility ('The dog is in front of the house', 'The dog walked in front of the house', 'the family has a responsibility *to* the dog'). *Собака стоит перед домом.* **Между** means 'between' or 'among', similar to **среди** + *gen*, 'among' (e.g., 'He stood between them'). *Он стоял между ними. Между мной и тобой нет секрета.* — From the Wikibooks Russian textbook (CC BY-SA 4.0).  ·  From Антон Чехов, «Письмо брату Николаю (1886)».
exercises.context: Перед means 'before' or 'in front of' in terms of positioning, and can also indicate responsibility ('The dog is in front of the house', 'The dog walked in front of the house', 'the family has a responsibility *to* the dog').

exercises.q: Вам жму руку и остаюсь ___ (постоянный слуга)
exercises.why: Masculine adjectives of the "hard" and "guttural" types have in the nominative the ending **-ой** if stressed: **новый** — **молодой**; **русский** — **плохой**, and retain the stress on the ending throughout the declension. The adjective «**большой**» belongs to the guttural type, in spite of its **-ш**-: **большого**, **большому**, **большим**, **о большом**. — DLI, Lessons 46 and 47.  ·  From Антон Чехов, «Письмо брату Николаю (1886)».
exercises.context: Masculine adjectives of the "hard" and "guttural" types have in the nominative the ending **-ой** if stressed: **новый** — **молодой**; **русский** — **плохой**, and retain the stress on the ending throughout the declension.

exercises.q: Читать их было некогда, ибо она стояла над ___ (душа) и требовала послать сейчас…
exercises.why: **Над** means 'over' or 'above', and **под** means 'under' or 'beneath'. **Под** + *inst* means 'under' if there is no motion involved - if there's motion, use **под** + *acc* instead ('The book is under the bed' - no movement, 'The book slid under the bed' - movement). **Под** + *inst* can also mean 'physically near', and **под** + *acc* can mean 'temporally near' or 'near in time' ('They live *near* the city' - physically near). — From the Wikibooks Russian textbook (CC BY-SA 4.0).  ·  From Антон Чехов, «Письмо брату Николаю (1886)».
exercises.context: Над** means 'over' or 'above', and **под means 'under' or 'beneath'.

exercises.why: **Между** means 'between' or 'among', similar to **среди** + *gen*, 'among' (e.g., 'He stood between them'). *Он стоял между ними. Между мной и тобой нет секрета.* **За** generally means 'behind' or 'beyond', but has a few nuances to it. — From the Wikibooks Russian textbook (CC BY-SA 4.0).  ·  From Антон Чехов, «Письмо брату Николаю (1886)».
exercises.context: Между** means 'between' or 'among', similar to **среди + *gen*, 'among' (e.g., 'He stood between them').

exercises.why: Notice that the feminine adjectives have the same ending **-ой** (**-ей**) for all cases except for the nominative and accusative. — DLI, Lessons 46 and 47.  ·  From Антон Чехов, «Письмо брату Николаю (1886)».
exercises.context: Notice that the feminine adjectives have the same ending **-ой** (**-ей**) for all cases except for the nominative and accusative.

exercises.q: ___ (мама) просит меня передать Вам низкий поклон, сестра тоже.
exercises.why: The only rules that are used in the nominative case are those to turn a word into its plural form (each case has its own rules for converting a word into the singular of that case, and into that case's plural form). The nominative case is used when no other case is being used. — From the Wikibooks Russian textbook (CC BY-SA 4.0). From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lesson 16.  ·  From Антон Чехов, «Письмо брату Николаю (1886)».
exercises.context: The only rules that are used in the nominative case are those to turn a word into its plural form (each case has its own rules for converting a word into the singular of that case, and into that case's plural form).

exercises.q: Особый интерес ___ (представлять) высказывания Чехова по эстетическим вопросам.
exercises.why: The following verbs belong to the "**Е**" type of conjugation: **думать** — **я думаю**, **ты думаешь** … **они думают**; **слушать**; **спрашивать**. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 16–18.  ·  From Антон Чехов, «Письмо брату Николаю (1886)».
exercises.context: The following verbs belong to the "**Е**" type of conjugation: **думать** — **я думаю**, **ты думаешь** … **они думают**; **слушать**; **спрашивать**.

exercises.q: Вы их уже изучили, наверно, и ___ (понять) сами.
exercises.why: The perfective future consists of one word only and resembles in form the present tense. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.  ·  From Антон Чехов, «Письмо брату Николаю (1886)».
exercises.context: The perfective future consists of one word only and resembles in form the present tense.
